summary: Northern Oil and Gas, Inc. (NOG) filed an 8-K reporting its completed acquisition of oil and gas assets from Parallax Energy Operating Inc. for CA$237.0M in cash (including a CA$37.5M escrow deposit) plus 3,689,413 NOG common shares. The cash portion is subject to post-closing settlement and was funded via cash on hand, free cash flow, and the revolving credit facility. NOG also entered into a registration rights agreement for the stock consideration. The deal was previously announced on May 22, 2026, and closed on June 1, 2026. Watch for final purchase price adjustments and potential dilution from share resales.
